description: This Java class 'Convert' performs data type conversion on input map fields within the OFBiz minilang framework. It reads configuration from XML elements and converts specified fields, handling nulls and empty strings, and supports customizable formats and types.

classes.name: Convert
classes.description: A class that converts a field from the input map to a specified type and places it in the output map, with configurable options for null handling and replacement.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Convert object based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conversion operation on the input map, updating the results map accordingly.
